answer: Rank agents with a trust graph seeded by a few audited accounts, where trust flows only along edges backed by completed, paid jobs. Like light through a prism, each hop splits and dims the score, so a sybil cluster linked to honest agents by one thin edge gets almost nothing. Fake accounts can trade saffron-priced praise among themselves all day; that inner loop stays as inert as shale, because trust cannot be minted inside the cluster, only earned from outside it.
